title: Specification
description: One city specification, as read from a specification file.

crossings.description: The bridges and fords placed by rules; a road over a river has one without a listing.

defences.description: The city's walls, citadel and gates; none when the file has no `defences` key.

identity.description: The city's name, seed and notes.

open_space.description: The city's market squares, plazas, greens and parade grounds.

roads.description: The roads that reach or cross the site; at least one (validation, #97).

schema.description: The schema version of the file; version 1 is the only one that exists.

site.description: The land the map shows, before the city: its size and its water.

AlongWater.description: What stands where a wall's area meets coast, river or lake.

oneOf.description: A sea or river wall, the default.

Band.description: An outside cover placed in one direction, reaching in from the site's edge.

bearing_degrees.description: The direction from the site's centre toward the band.

cover.description: The cover the band is made of.

depth_metres.description: How far the band reaches in from the site's edge.

Bearing.description: a bearing: whole degrees from 0 to 359 in plain digits, or a compass word such as `south_east`

Canal.description: A dug waterway that enters the site at one edge stretch and leaves at another.

from.description: The edge stretch where the canal enters.

identifier.description: The canal's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

to.description: The edge stretch where the canal leaves.

Citadel.description:
The city's own stronghold, part of a wall on one side of that wall's area: its outer side is
the wall. A ward around a castle is a pinned `defence` landmark instead (ADR-064).

bearing_degrees.description: The side of the wall's area it stands on, from the centre of that area.

identifier.description: The citadel's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

wall.description: The wall it is part of.

Cliff.description: A sheer drop of the ground on one side of the site.

bearing_degrees.description: The direction from the site's centre toward the cliff.

Coast.description: The sea's edge: where the sea lies, the coastline's shape and what the shore is made of.

bearing_degrees.description: The direction from the site's centre toward the sea.

shore.description: What the shore is made of; the generator picks when the file has none.

oneOf.description: The sea reaches into the land in a curve.
A straight coast along open sea.
A narrow sea between this land and other land.
A river widens into the sea; it needs a river that reaches the sea there.

CompassRegion.description:
One of the eight compass directions or `centre`; as a river or road end, a stretch of the
site's edge (`centre` is not an edge and is rejected there by validation).

oneOf.description: The middle of the site, not an edge.

hard.description: Whether the rule must hold; false when the file says nothing.

weight.description: How much a soft rule counts; `Weight::DEFAULT` when the file says nothing.

target.description: `near`, `far_from` and the wall and district rules: what the rule points to.

Crossing.description: A bridge or ford placed by rules (ADR-062); it fixes how streets cross the river.

constraints.description: The rules that place the crossing.

identifier.description: The crossing's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

kind.description: Whether it is a bridge or a ford.

pinned.description: Whether `resolved` is kept exactly; false when the file says nothing.

resolved.description: Where the crossing lies, written by the generator or by hand.

river.description: The identifier of the river it crosses.

citadel.description: The city's own stronghold, if it has one (ADR-064).

gates.description: The gates that rules can point to, and the gates without a road (ADR-064).

walls.description: The walls; what each encloses comes only from its `encloses` list.

District.description:
A district of the city (ADR-060): what it is for, how rich it is, and the rules that place
it. The generator assigns wards to it; `weight` is its size relative to the other districts.

constraints.description: The rules that place the district.

enclosure.description:
Whether the district has its own boundary, which is only drawn; open when the file
says nothing.

group.description: A free word rule packs may read, such as `jotun`; none when the file has none.

identifier.description: The district's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

jurisdiction.description: Who governs the district; the town when the file says nothing.

notes.description: Free text the generator ignores; empty when the file has none.

wealth.description: How rich the district is; middling when the file says nothing.

weight.description: The district's size relative to the other districts.

DistrictFunction.description: What a district is for. A culture's own quarters map onto one of these in a rule pack.

oneOf.description: Noxious or water-bound industry, such as tanneries and dye works.
Where the city is ruled from.
A walled or set-apart religious ground.

Enclosure.description: Whether a district has its own boundary.

oneOf.description: No boundary of its own, the default.

Era.description: The historical era of a city, written in snake case in a file (`early_medieval`).

Footprint.description:
The size a file asks for a landmark; each part is optional and overrides the defaults
of its function and label (specification-version-1 §3).

class.description: The size class whose area range the generator draws from.

depth_metres.description: The depth, the long side of the shape when the generator draws the size.

FootprintClass.description: A landmark's size class, from a 2 m well to a 100 m palace (specification-version-1 §3).

end.description: `road_gate`: which of the road's ends picks the crossing.

wall.description: The wall the gate is in.

bearing_degrees.description: `postern` and `water_gate`: the side of the wall's area.

wall.description: The wall the gate is in.

bearing_degrees.description: `postern` and `water_gate`: the side of the wall's area.

wall.description: The wall the gate is in.

Gradient.description:
A fall of the ground in metres per kilometre, such as a slope's: zero or more, with the
same range and rounding as `Length`.

Harbour.description: A harbour on the site's coast or river.

bearing_degrees.description:
The direction from the site's centre toward the harbour; a coast or a river end lies
within `HARBOUR_WATER_DEGREES` of it (validation).

identifier.description: The harbour's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

length_metres.description: How long the harbour's waterfront is.

Hill.description: A rise of the ground around a point.

at.description: Where the hill stands; `centre` is the site's centre.

height_metres.description: How high the top stands above the ground around it.

radius_metres.description: How far the hill reaches from its top.

Hollow.description: A dip of the ground around a point.

at.description: Where the hollow lies; `centre` is the site's centre.

depth_metres.description: How deep the lowest point lies below the ground around it.

radius_metres.description: How far the hollow reaches from its lowest point.

Identity.description: The city's name, its default seed and free notes for the GM.

name.description: The city's name, shown on the map.

notes.description: Free text the generator ignores; empty when the file has none.

seed.description: The master seed used when the command line gives none.

Importance.description: How important a road or a landmark is; the order is from least to most important.

InsideCover.description: A cover of the ground inside a city.

oneOf.description: Someone else, such as a castle or a church.

Lake.description: A lake around a point of the site.

at.description: Where the lake lies; `centre` is the site's centre.

identifier.description: The lake's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

radius_metres.description: How far the lake reaches from its middle.

LandCover.description:
What covers the ground (ADR-058). A name in `outside` or `inside` says the cover is
there and lets the generator place it; a band places an outside cover itself.

bands.description: Outside covers placed as a band reaching in from the site's edge.

inside.description: Covers inside the city that the generator places.

outside.description: Covers around the city that the generator places.

Landmark.description:
A landmark of the city (ADR-061): a building or monument the map numbers and the legend
names. Without `pinned` the generator places it by its rules.

constraints.description: The rules that place the landmark.

footprint.description: The size the file asks for; the generator picks it when the file has none.

identifier.description: The landmark's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

importance.description: How important the landmark is; minor when the file says nothing.

label.description: A free word the legend shows and rule packs match, such as `cathedral`.

notes.description: Free text the generator ignores; empty when the file has none.

pinned.description: Whether `resolved` is kept exactly; false when the file says nothing.

resolved.description: Where the landmark stands, written by the generator or by hand.

LandmarkFunction.description: What a landmark is for; each has a default footprint class and shape in the rule pack.

oneOf.description: A church, temple, mosque or shrine.
A castle, keep, tower or gatehouse.
A town hall, guildhall or courthouse.
A market hall, warehouse or exchange.
A hospital, bathhouse or leper house.
A well, fountain, mill or lighthouse.
A column, market cross or statue.
A smithy, tannery, brewery or other workshop.

Length.description: Metres, zero or more, rounded to the centimetre.

OpenSpace.description:
A square, green or parade ground (ADR-062). Without `pinned` the generator places it by
its rules and draws its size from its kind's range in the rule pack.

constraints.description: The rules that place the open space.

identifier.description: The open space's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

kind.description: What kind of open space it is.

pinned.description: Whether `resolved` is kept exactly; false when the file says nothing.

resolved.description: Where the open space lies, written by the generator or by hand.

OpenSpaceKind.description: What kind of open space it is.

OutsideCover.description: A cover of the ground around a city.

Placement.description:
Where a landmark, open space or crossing stands: its centre in the site frame, measured
from the south-west corner, its turn and its size, so a pin keeps its size too.

rotation_degrees.description: The turn, clockwise from north, from 0 up to 360 (validation).

x.description: The centre's distance east of the site's west edge.

y.description: The centre's distance north of the site's south edge.

Plateau.description: A raised flat part on one side of the site.

bearing_degrees.description: The direction from the site's centre toward the plateau.

height_metres.description: How high the plateau stands above the rest of the site.

Presets.description: Generation presets that pick defaults for the whole city (ADR-065).

centre_radius_metres.description:
The radius around the town core that counts as `centre`; `CENTRE_RADIUS_METRES` when
the file gives none.

era.description: The historical era whose defaults the generator uses.

packs.description: The names of the rule packs on top of the default pack, in file order.

reuse_positions.description: Whether an unpinned object with a `resolved` placement gets a soft rule to stay near it.

reuse_weight.description: How much that soft rule counts; `Weight::DEFAULT` when the file gives none.

reuse_within_metres.description: How far that soft rule reaches; `REUSE_WITHIN_METRES` when the file gives none.

style.description: The drawing style's name; `DEFAULT_STYLE` when the file gives none.

River.description: A river that enters the site at one edge stretch and leaves at another.

from.description: The edge stretch where the river enters.

identifier.description: The river's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

to.description: The edge stretch where the river leaves.

RiverCrossingKind.description: What is built where a road crosses a river.

Road.description: A road that reaches or crosses the site (specification-version-1 §2). It has no direction.

ends.description: Where the road starts and ends; the first end is where crossing numbers start.

identifier.description: The road's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

importance.description: How important the road is; a major road outranks a minor one.

river_crossing.description: What a crossing of this road over a river is; a bridge when the file says nothing.

RoadEnd.description:
One end of a road, written in a file as one word: a compass region, `core`, or the
identifier of a pinned landmark or open space. Region names and `core` are read first, so
they are reserved and never name a place (specification-version-1 §5).

Rotation.description: Degrees from 0 up to 360, rounded to 0.01.

Seed.description:
The master seed of one generation run, as given on the command line or in a specification
file, where it is written as a plain number.

Settlement.description: The settlement's size: the only size input of the generator.

Shore.description: What a shore is made of.

Site.description: The site: the square piece of land the map shows, measured from its south-west corner.

extent_metres.description: The side of the square site; the whole city fits inside it.

land_cover.description:
What covers the ground around and inside the city; none when the file has no
`land_cover` key.

terrain.description: The shape of the land; none when the file has no `terrain` key.

water.description: The water on the site; none when the file has no `water` key.

Slope.description: A tilt of the whole site.

metres_per_kilometre.description: How far the ground falls per kilometre.

toward_degrees.description: The direction the ground falls toward.

Terrain.description:
The shape of the land as named features (ADR-056). The words are the file's vocabulary,
not generation rules: S0 turns every feature into one ground.

coast.description: The sea's edge, if the site has one.

hills.description: Rises of the ground around a point.

hollows.description: Dips of the ground around a point, the mirror image of a hill.

plateau.description: A raised flat part of the site, if it has one.

slope.description: A tilt of the whole site, if it has one.

Wall.description:
A wall: the outline of the area its enclosed districts cover. Two walls whose areas touch
share that stretch, unless the inner one keeps a `separate_ring`.

along_water.description: What stands where the enclosed area meets coast, river or lake; a wall by default.

encloses.description: The districts and walls inside it; a wall inside it brings that wall's districts too.

gap_metres.description: The gap of a separate ring; `SEPARATE_RING_GAP_METRES` when the file gives none.

identifier.description: The wall's identifier in this file, unique across the whole file.

kind.description: What the wall is built of.

separate_ring.description: Whether this wall keeps a gap from a wall outside it instead of sharing its line.

WallKind.description: What a wall is built of.

oneOf.description: The line of a torn-down wall.

Water.description: The water on the site; the generator reads only rivers until later milestones.

canals.description: Dug waterways from one edge stretch to another; read now, generated from milestone 5.

harbour.description: The harbour, if the site has one.

rivers.description: The rivers that cross the site, from one edge stretch to another.

tidal.description:
Whether the sea rises and falls with the tide; only drawn, false when the file says
nothing.

oneOf.description: Neither poor nor rich, the default.

Weight.description:
How much a soft rule counts against the other soft rules of its object: zero or more,
with the same range and rounding as `Length` (ADR-059).
